scientific_integrity: Ordinary singularity counts are proved by a complete rank-two flat classification, rank-three avoidance and transversality on the Fermat surface; finite computation is supplementary. Earlier reflection and center results are credited and a bibliographic residual risk is recorded.
scientific_limitations: Over the complex numbers only, even degrees at least four; no claim for odd degrees, positive characteristic, equisingular deformations, or global log resolutions.
title: Singularities of the reflection divisor on even-degree Fermat surfaces
